title: Transfer: Bus Reliability Small-Multiples Dashboard
goal: Build a D3 operations dashboard from local transit CSV files that plots bus route on-time performance through the day using small-multiple line charts, includes a hover focus or brush to inspect a time window, and updates a detail table with the worst-performing stops and delay counts for the selected route or interval.
skillBenefitRationale: This applies the skill in a clearly different setting centered on time scales, axes, line generation, focus interactions, and stateful cross-filtering, while still making D3 the only critical shipped skill.
